title: COMPUTATIONAL LAW: DATASETS, BENCHMARKS, AND ONTOLOGIES

bias_targets.methodology: The paper reviews the 'FairLex' benchmark, which evaluates pre-trained language models for fairness in legal text processing tasks such as legal judgment prediction and topic classification across multiple languages and jurisdictions.

The paper reviews the 'Super-SCOTUS' dataset, which includes annotations for the political direction of US Supreme Court decisions, classifying them into a binary task of either 'conservative' or 'liberal'.
